sn52.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn52.11:1.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anuruddhena …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn52.11:2.1: katamesaṃ āyasmā anuruddho dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ pattoti.
sn52.11:2.2: catunnaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ patto.
sn52.11:2.7: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.11:2.8: imesaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ patto.
sn52.11:2.9: imesañca panāhaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā kappasahassaṃ anussarāmīti.
